author: StoreyLane

title: A Game-Changer for ADHD - 5 Stars!
body:
Focus Genie has been a life-altering tool for me as a black woman with ADHD. It's comprehensive, offering strategies and education that resonate with my neurodivergent brain. It's not just an app; it's a personal guide that's accessible and easy to navigate. 

Beyond helping me understand ADHD, Focus Genie has been instrumental in my day-to-day life, aiding my healing process and enhancing my productivity. A huge thank you to Dr. Sasha Hamdani for creating such a powerful tool.

For anyone living with ADHD, I can't recommend Focus Genie enough. It's a beacon of hope, proving that with the right resources, we can thrive. Five stars aren't enough for this transformative app.

Diane Rudakenga

author: StewJu

title: Early days
body:
I was really excited to try this app, and continue to have high hopes but it needs some improvement. It won’t let me check off my To Do list as it keeps saying it’s in read only. 
I also would like to see some To Dos carry over to the next day because they are daily tasks not just tasks I want to do that particular day. Recreating a new task list daily is too hard for me. 

I think this app has the best potential I’ve seen among ADHD apps so far! I think after a few iterations I’d be ready to subscribe again. I would really like to see what my monthly data collection would tell me. 
Unfortunately it has only a 3 day trial so I unsubscribed prior to exploring any more of what it had to offer. 

Looking forward to seeing how this app evolves after feedback!

title: Beware - no real trial
body:

Yes, they say you can cancel within the three days and you will allegedly not be charged, but I’ve seen that not happen with so many apps. I’ve found honest app companies let you trial it or at least look around at the locked content before you hand over your credit card. Not certain why they are not doing this? Can’t really rate it well. Can’t even go back and look at the initial product run-through. It’s just stuck on the subscription screen. The rating is based on above.

title: Some feedback
body:
As someone with ADHD who is also a therapist specializing in ADHD I’m so grateful for people like Dr. Hamdani for creating tools to make mental things physical. the task timer doesn’t make a sound when it’s time to take a break.  The push notifications weren’t working. 

Tasks can’t be set to repeat

Reword questions so they aren’t yes or no.  For example “how are you different from your siblings?” instead of “are you different from your siblings?”

The “mark as read” thing is very small - make it a button.

When I used the timer:

When I switched over to another app like messages, the study buddy image disappeared.  Also once the app closed and my timer reset.  Study buddy also froze regularly.  Timer is inaccurate if you switch over to another app.

Thanks for considering my feedback!

title: Potential, but not there yet
body:
I was really excited about this app and do feel like I can see the vision, but it feels like there are some core features that are missing that should have been part of the first iteration. Like others have mentioned, there’s no way to build daily routines into the task list or sync with your calendar, so it just creates another place to look and requires time every day to go in and build out the list. Also, I love the idea of the focus tracker, but there’s no notification or reminder to complete it and you can’t complete it for previous days. 

I would also love to see integration with other apps as the app matures: 
-Importing tasks from Apple Reminders (where my partner or Siri will add things to a shared list for me when I remember them while busy) or Outlook (where my work tasks live)
-Integration with Apple Health to pull sleep/water/medication/exercise data that are already tracked and then used to compare with focus tracking trends

Overall, I do think there’s a lot of potential for this app to be very helpful, but until it can be more of a comprehensive way to track things, it will likely be an app that I remember to use periodically.

author: KM5736

title: Incredible app, but quite buggy
body:
I downloaded this app today (9/25). Here are some of my thoughts:

Pros
- I was hooked from the moment I opened the app! The tutorial was extensive but really succinct, and the app is super user-friendly without being childish. It truly feels like it was made by people with ADHD for people with ADHD!
- It has a bunch of functionality that I use multiple different apps for, which is so helpful! And I love that you can make to-dos from voice notes!
- The info in the learning tab is actually really quick and ADHD-friendly without being infantilizing. The tips are a bit general, but then again they’re general tips for general people. 
- I really like the little genie dude! 

Cons
- I had an error when I tried to submit a learning bite and had to start over. 
- I also had an error when I tried to submit an answer to a journal prompt and had to start over. 
- When entering a journal submission, the keyboard gets in the way of the submit button, so submitting can be frustrating

Other thoughts:
- I like that there’s is a color to indicate what the prompt is for today, but I wish it were a different color - red feels kind of negative, as if I missed the prompt for the day. Also, it would be cool if the prompt changed color once I submit my response! 
- For me, a longer trial period would be helpful to see how well this fits into my daily schedule / try the app after some of the bugs are fixed. 
- Would be cool to see some videos of this being used circulating around social media! 

Overall, I’m really excited about this app! I would definitely pay $50/yr for this once the major bugs are fixed!

When you finish a learning module, you get an error message saying it doesn’t register that you’ve finished. Very excited about this app, but the number of bugs makes it a lot less helpful than anticipated. The highlight of the app has been the learning feature. author: JLC2599

title: Needs work - too many bugs
body: Love the concept. Too many issues right away. Timer doesn’t  notify you’ve switch from work to break and vice versa. Can’t leave the app or timer turns off. Can’t check off to do list without timer ( which isn’t reliable)  would love to see I completed tasks carry over to following day and have a way to set up daily/weekly/monthly tasks as well as one offs for specific days. Would love to be able to upload journal prompts from photos or word.
author: BarryHappy

title: Needs Work
body: Brand new app needs a lot of work. Slim offering with some rudimentary educational material and a todo list doesn’t warrant the price point right now.
